Alex (AE): Quick heads-up: BankDelta sent SIG Q23 + Q24 (encryption at rest + key mgmt). They need evidence by Thu EOD. Who can own artifacts and the answer text?
Priya - SE: I can own the answers. Do we know if customer will be Hosted (EU) or Dedicated? That changes what we can show.
Noah - Security: Confirmed Hosted (EU region) per sales notes. For Hosted we can share SaaS KMS screenshots and redacted key-usage logs. We cannot share private HSM material for other customers. Also legal wants any email addresses removed before external distribution.
Lina - Solutions: I'll build an evidence manifest (CSV) mapping each SIG question -> short answer -> artifacts -> shareable flag. I can also generate pre-signed links and a one-pager summary.
Alex (AE): Thanks. Priya, can you paste a proposed short-answer for Q23 so Noah can sanity-check language? Keep it customer-facing.
Priya - SE: Draft:
```
Q23 (Encryption at rest): Yes. Data is encrypted at rest using envelope encryption. DEKs encrypt object data; KEKs are stored in cloud KMS (HSM-backed, FIPS 140-2 Level 3). KEKs rotate every 90 days; DEKs rotate annually. Access to key operations is restricted by RBAC and recorded in immutable logs retained for 12 months. Artifacts: kms_policy_redacted.pdf, key_usage_2025_redacted.csv, kms-diagram.png.
```
Noah - Security: OK overall. Edit: change "HSM-backed" to "HSM-backed cloud KMS" and add "separation of duties between ops and crypto-admin roles". Also note: logs are retained in EU for EU-region tenants.
Priya - SE: Updated:
```
Q23 (Encryption at rest): Yes. Data is encrypted at rest using envelope encryption. DEKs encrypt object data; KEKs are stored in an HSM-backed cloud KMS (FIPS 140-2 Level 3). KEKs rotate every 90 days; DEKs rotate annually. Key operations are limited via RBAC, separation of duties is enforced, and operations are recorded in immutable logs retained for 12 months in the EU region. Artifacts: kms_policy_redacted.pdf, key_usage_2025_redacted.csv, kms-diagram.png.
```
Lina - Solutions: Good. I'll prepare: rotation_policy_redacted.pdf, key_usage_2025_redacted.csv (PII removed), keystore_policy.json (redacted), and kms-diagram.png. Also will generate sig_manifest.csv.
Noah - Security: Please note: rotation_policy_redacted.pdf needs legal stamp removed. I can do redaction if you drop a copy in the secure share.

Priya - SE: Yes: single-sentence addendum: "For Dedicated deployments customers can supply and manage keys (including HSMs) in their environment; Hosted uses our cloud KMS."
